other_conditions: The child must be an Indian citizen
The achievement/act/incident should have occurred within 2 years of the last date of receipt of application/nomination for the year of consideration
The child must have made outstanding contributions in any of the seven specified categories (Bravery, Art & Culture, Environment, Innovation, Science & Technology, Social Service, Sports)
benefits_summary: Medal, Certificate and citation are awarded to the child.
documents_required: Name as per Aadhaar/Valid Identity Proof
Type of Organization (if applying as organization)
Name of the Authorized Person as per Aadhaar/Valid Identity Proof
